summary: {person} asks whether a dot on the project map means a renovation or a building opened for winter use.
realLife: Seattle’s 2026 Park District board presentation distinguished completed restroom renovations from completed weatherization projects on its map.
gates: A completion map with distinct categories and a facility project ledger.
weights: A site appearing in a capital report can prompt questions about what residents gained.
inGame: needs: project ID, site ID, work category and completion date.

turns.what: The director describes the winter service it enables.

turns.pulledBy: The facility also received a renovation.
turns.writesBack: Link the two completion records without counting one as the other.
